87143a0f5f489430.title: City of Santa Clarita’s 2026 State of the City: Rolling Into the Future
87143a0f5f489430.desc: City of Santa Clarita's 2026 State of the City on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Mayor Laurene Weste, Mayor Pro Tem Patsy Ayala, Councilmember Jason Gibbs, Councilmember Bill Miranda and Councilwoman Marsha McLean cordially invite you to celebrate the past year and roll into the future at this year’s State of the City, as we celebrate the opening of the highly anticipated The Rink Sports Pavilion. The Rink is designed to be an active and welcoming space for all ages and will offer opportunities for roller skating, sports and family fun. This year’s event will highlight all of the incredible projects and programs our City has completed over the past year and offer a glimpse into the exciting projects that will define Santa Clarita’s future. Guests will enjoy a presentation from the City Council, a commemorative gift, beverages and light bites. The event will be held on Thursday, October 22, at 3:00 p.m. at The Rink Sports Pavilion (20860 Centre Pointe Parkway). For more information, contact the City at (661) 255-4939, or drodriguez2@santaclarita.gov.
